title: Universal Car Tuner Speed Modify Gui
features:
Join The Discord https://discord.gg/RZk3EwryQp

A Mostly Universal Car Tuning Script made by Me Aoruen
allows you to modify the speed of all A-Chassis Cars which it pretty much everything except for a few niche games

Steps-
1. Run Script
2. sit in the car of choice
3. Select a preset or use the sliders to modify the speed, smoothness and acceleration of the vehicle when holding W
